subject.title: Feature Request: Slack-Style @Mention Autocomplete in Control UI Chat

question: Should @agent autocomplete extend the existing Control UI slash/composer and agents.list metadata path, introduce a dedicated agents.directory plus rich-chip editor path, or be deferred into a broader composer-suggestion design?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing composer behavior and possibly new gateway API surface, and current code already has both a slash suggestion model and agent metadata that may be sufficient.

options.title: Scope shared composer suggestions
options.body: Use the current slash-menu and agents.list surfaces as the starting point, adding API surface only for proven metadata gaps.

options.title: Approve dedicated @agent directory and chips
options.body: Treat agents.directory and rich mention chips as a new Control UI/API direction with explicit accessibility, IME, paste, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer to broader web chat UX planning
options.body: Keep chat composer suggestions slash-only until maintainers scope related @agent and custom-term autocomplete together.

recommendation.title: Scope shared composer suggestions
recommendation.body: Use the current slash-menu and agents.list surfaces as the starting point, adding API surface only for proven metadata gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest nearby product-triage signal for the composer suggestion direction and adjacent autocomplete request.
